summary.text: Christina Wolff is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 38 (Minot) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Christina Wolff's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Christina Wolff's committee assignments as including the Government and Veterans Affairs and the Judiciary standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Christina Wolff's occupation as Business Owner.
Christina Wolff is listed as married to Brad with 4 children.
